name: ECA Group
description: Integrate ECA with the Group module and its plugins.
project_description: ECA Group is a small integration module that bridges the ECA (Events-Conditions-Actions) no-code automation framework with the Group module. In this 1.0.x release it adds exactly two ECA plugins: an action that compares the members contained in two lists of group memberships (list diff / intersect), and a condition that verifies whether the current user holds a given group permission within a given group. It ships no events, no membership-mutating actions, no services, no routes and no permissions of its own; the plugins are used as building blocks inside ECA models configured through the ECA UI.
